bodyAsJson.subject: Case Reference Number {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.caseReferenceNumber'}} - Notice of First Directions Appointment (FDA)
bodyAsJson.html:
Reference no: {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.caseReferenceNumber'}}

Your Ref: MNT12345

Baggins vs Gollum

Dear Sauron,

This case has been listed for {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.hearingType'}}, the hearing notice and details can be found on the 'Hearings' tab.

Sign in to your account to continue.

https://manage-case.platform.hmcts.net/

If you do not yet have access to this case, speak to your organisation's case access administrator (CAA) to make sure this case is assigned to you. You will not be able to access the case until it has been assigned to you.

Upload case files and submit these files for the hearing.

https://manage-case.platform.hmcts.net/

What happens next

The Notice of {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.hearingType'}} may explain which documents you must file with the Court and serve on the other party or you will have an order confirming the same.

Help us improve this service

Please tell us what you think of the Contested Financial Remedy service it and how it can be improved at http://www.smartsurvey.co.uk/s/KCECE/.

If you need help

Guidance on MYHMCTS

https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/myhmcts-how-to-complete-case-administration-tasks/complete-case-administration-tasks-in-myhmcts#tell-us-you-are-representing-a-party-on-the-case-notice-of-change

Guidance on using the FR Contested portal

https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/myhmcts-how-to-use-online-financial-remedy-services

You can contact the court if you need help.

Financial Remedies Court: {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.courtName'}}

Email: {{jsonPath request.body '$.personalisation.courtEmail'}}

HM Courts & Tribunals Service

This is an automated message, please don't reply to this email.
